principle: Size is NOT token count or file count. Size is a composite, deterministic classification over ten explicit dimensions, each scored 0..3 by an explicit rubric. The classifier is a PURE function (same inputs -> same size, same reasons). Scores are justified by evidence reasons; a dimension with insufficient evidence contributes 0 AND flags under_classified (never silently assumed).

sizeTiers.label: trivial
sizeTiers.expected: single-line or a few-line local edit, one file, no dependency, no ambiguity, deterministic verify
sizeTiers.lifecycleHint: fast path eligible ONLY if risk == LOW (risk axis is independent and dominates)

sizeTiers.label: small
sizeTiers.expected: small focused change, 1-3 files, one subsystem, shallow dependency depth
sizeTiers.lifecycleHint: standard lightweight path; direct execution allowed; review strength from risk

sizeTiers.label: medium
sizeTiers.expected: multi-file change across one subsystem or a few, some ambiguity, moderate verification burden
sizeTiers.lifecycleHint: decomposition recommended; research gate if ambiguity >= 2; worktree isolation for writers

sizeTiers.label: large
sizeTiers.expected: cross-subsystem change, deep dependency chains, significant verification burden
sizeTiers.lifecycleHint: decomposition REQUIRED; research-first; read-only discovery; durable execution recommended; independent review

sizeTiers.label: multi-stage
sizeTiers.expected: multi-subsystem, multi-stage program of work, stateful, high rollback complexity
sizeTiers.lifecycleHint: decomposition into stages REQUIRED; durable execution + checkpoint/resume REQUIRED; controller gates per stage; external review per authoritative surface

rubric: 3 = long-lived state across sessions / durable execution required

classificationContract.deterministic: score(tier) = pure function of (dimension scores); reasons array REQUIRED for every non-zero dimension
classificationContract.evidence: each dimension score must carry at least one reason; classification evidence captured BEFORE execution (from card text + preliminary discovery)
classificationContract.boundedRefinement: size MAY be refined once after preliminary read-only discovery, BEFORE any mutation; after admission is bound (execution starts), size is frozen (drift = HOLD)
classificationContract.failClosed: insufficient evidence -> dimension contributes 0 AND under_classified flag set -> classifier must NOT default to S; under_classified with ambiguity >= 1 escalates to research-first (see risk/escalation)
classificationContract.noTokenHeuristic: token estimate and file count are INPUTS to affected_files/expected_execution_steps scoring only; never the sole classifier
classificationContract.separation: size NEVER overrides risk: a 3-line change with a destructive signal is CRITICAL regardless of XS size (see risk model). Size only selects lifecycle WEIGHT among risk-compatible profiles.

examples.description: fix one typo in a doc file
delete a row from a production database
examples.note: XS size + CRITICAL risk -> full critical lifecycle, NEVER fast path

examples.description: add a parameterized test + fix the function across 2 files
introduce a new memory write-back source with trust ladder changes
